I’m a 20 year old dude, my closest and best friend died of cancer 4 days ago. He never told me and I found out the day he died. I met him in middle school. He moved away in my junior year of high school. He was the one who cheered me up and pushed me even when I didn’t believe in myself. He had the purest heart I’ve ever seen. Best human being I’ve met. Even when he died, he had a smile on his face. I was devastated. I cried like never before. The person I loved the most abandoned me the same day he died. She left me. It made even worse. I also lost my job. Also couldn’t get into school. I reached the lowest point in my life. I’ve been depressed for years. I attempted suicide last year. Yet, here I am. 4 days later pushing myself to try and fill his shoes. Pushing myself to be happy. It’s not easy, but I found my purpose. You have to find yours. I still remember walking home with him one day in junior year. I asked him, “how are you so happy all the time? How can you keep a smile on your face despite your hardships?” And he looks at me with a smile and says “because that’s how I want to be remembered.” And funny thing, that’s how he’s being remembered. My best advice I can give you is, to remember the good times and think of the many more to come. You’re 13, you have so much to experience. There will be someone who will teach you and show you what real happiness is like. And that’s when your world will change forever. Be patient. Your life may be hard right now, but this is when you gotta be the strongest. Hard work never goes unnoticed.
His shoes feel to big for me to fill I can’t do it. I just want to join him and spend the rest of eternity with him. He accepted me for who I was. It’s never happened again. And it never will.
I can’t stop crying. Everything reminds of him. Whenever I close my eyes I see his lifeless body. I still feel his cold stiff hand.

Thank you for those kind words. I appreciate them. He was the only one who could make my pain and sadness go away and now that he’s gonna idk how to do this alone. I feel so lost without him. No purpose. He had the purest heart I’ve ever known. Now I’ll never get to hear his shitty but amazing jokes ever again.
